cases.title: Review due: intent asked first, Cut as the target, no demo, walkthrough or menu path

rubric.reason: Turn 3 gives the task in two short sentences ("Make it snap, then say "done".") with no demo, walkthrough, menu path or reteach.
Turn 2 opens with the real question "Is anything here meant to snap, like a blink, an on/off, or a cut?" and raises Cut only as a question, not as a focus it set itself.
Cut, Opacity, 3 s, 3.1 s, 100 to 0 and the Seal precomp all match the snapshot results, and Blink's Opacity "last week" matches the record (8 days).
